text:
pagerbot: PAGERS — ingress-gateway:5xx spike in us-west-2; error rate 11% over last 5m, latency increased. Trigger: threshold breach. Paging @Jordan (oncall).

Jordan (oncall): ack. joining call. any known customer-facing impact?

Ashley: seeing elevated 502/504s in support telemetry; multiple customer sessions failing at request step. attaching sample correlation ids: cid=a1f3d2, cid=b7c9e0, cid=c2d4f5

Sara: I can pull KV logs. requesting time window 15:12-15:20 UTC. I'll upload bundle to s3.

Mike: initial look — gateway is spiking 504s with upstream conn reset patterns. suspect downstream service X's retry policy is amplifying. hypothesis: upstream cascading retries -> connection pool exhaustion -> gateway timeouts.

Jordan (oncall): mitigation idea: temporarily disable retries at gateway routing tier for service X or increase its connection pool. Can we flip an emergency route to fallback pool?

Ben: rolling a quick config: `edge.routes.service-x.retries=0` for us-west-2. Pushing now.

eng-runtime-bot: deploy started by Ben. sha=abc123. ETA ~25s.

Ben: deployed. monitoring.

Mike: after flip, 5xx rate dropped to 3% in 3m. still seeing occasional tail 504s. looks like retry amplification was primary.

Jordan (oncall): good. Sara, please upload KV/log bundle and include trace bundles for the sample cids.

Sara: uploaded: s3://redwood-incident-bundles/2623456789-15_12-15_20.tar.gz

Sara: extracts: `tracebundle/` contains traces for a1f3d2,b7c9e0,c2d4f5. Link: https://s3.console.aws/…/2623456789-15_12-15_20

Mike: running quick grep on gateway logs: `rg "a1f3d2|b7c9e0|c2d4f5" /var/log/gateway/*.log` shows repeated upstream 502 followed by retry attempts. sample excerpt:

``
[15:14:02] req=cid=a1f3d2 upstream=svc-x-12:502 "read reset" retries=2
[15:14:02] req=cid=a1f3d2 gateway_timeout queued=123
``

Jordan (oncall): adding to incident timeline: 15:12 first spike; 15:13 retries amplify; 15:14 deploy to disable retries; 15:17 partial recovery; 15:30 normal. Need RCA doc after stabilization. Assign owners: Mike to draft root-cause, Ben to capture config change + hunt for retry origin, Sara to attach logs/traces to ticket.

Ashley: customer comm update: emailed affected customers, offering SLA credit; will post status page update once we have RCA draft.

Jordan (oncall): agree. Next actions: Mike write RCA, include hypothesis testing steps (replay traces against staging with retries on/off), Ben to open follow-up issue to add circuit-breaker and better backoff, Sara to keep log bundle in ticket and mark sensitive PII redacted.

Mike: ack. I'll start document and link to ticket INC-7629.

Jordan (oncall): thanks team. closing pager once 5xx rate <1% for 30m. :thumbsup:

pagerbot: Pager resolved — error rate returned to baseline. Incident marked mitigated; severity lowered to P2. Documentation link: INC-7629
